name: Mumbai Metropolitan Region Development Authority
summary: The planning body for greater Mumbai, which builds the region's big roads, sea links, flyovers and metro lines.
about: MMRDA plans and builds infrastructure across the whole Mumbai region rather than any single city, which is why it handles projects that cross municipal boundaries — the eastern and western express corridors, the Mumbai Trans Harbour Link across the bay, and much of the metro network. It works alongside the municipal corporations rather than replacing them: broadly, MMRDA builds the region-scale links and the corporations run the streets inside their own limits.
facts: Built the Mumbai Trans Harbour Link, India's longest sea bridge, opened in 2024.
Covers not just Mumbai but Thane, Navi Mumbai, Kalyan and the surrounding districts.
Also builds and funds much of the Mumbai metro network.
